final: WITH benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(f.feerate) as bench_rate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL), channel_rates AS (SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(f.feerate) as avg_fee_rate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.orderbase), above_benchmark AS (SELECT cr.avg_fee_rate, cr.avg_fee_rate - b.bench_rate as excess FROM channel_rates cr, benchmark b WHERE cr.avg_fee_rate > b.bench_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_fee_rate) as mean_of_avg_rates, AVG(excess) as mean_of_excesses FROM above_benchmark    -- Returns: (0.0010291190276711703, 1.811902767117239e-05)
